evidence: The Inland Pack Track traditionally starts from the Waikori Road car park with the crossing of a large suspension bridge.
The Inland Pack Track is recommended South to North following Fossil and Dilemma Creek downstream, but can also be done in reverse from the Fox River car park.
At the end of Waikori Road, 800 m south of the Paparoa National Park Visitor Centre.

doubts: The main way is the page's described direction, Waikori Road car park to Fox River car park. The reverse (from the Fox River car park) is the same crossing walked the other way, so it is not listed as a separate way. The Waikori Road car park is the road end feature F1; the Fox River car park has no feature, so it is null. The Bullock Creek and Fox River fords are read from 'There is no bridge across Bullock Creek' and 'A wide river crossing brings you to the true right of the river'; the page does not use the word ford. The Ballroom Overhang sentence sits at the end of the Fossil Creek section, so the place it leaves from is not named and from is null. The Cave Creek Memorial track ref (L3) is taken from the link with the same anchor text. The first section's suspension bridge is not named, so it has no ref. The Pororari River Track car park is an access point with no ref.
